note: The Delivery Book, for staff (20 October 2026: "a small video on the revised delivery process as it also looks up the client etc and the client gets an email confirming delivery"). Real staff by name, clients and figures made up.

scenes.headline: The Delivery Book
scenes.sub: Cheques, contracts and certificates, handed over and recorded
scenes.line: This is the Delivery Book. Every cheque, policy contract and certificate the branch hands over is recorded here, the same day.

scenes.headline: The Delivery Book, not the Log Book
scenes.line: Open the branch app, and tap Delivery Book. If it asks, enter your staff access code. The Log Book is for papers going to head office. Anything you hand over goes here.

scenes.headline: Find the client
scenes.line: Step one. Find the client. Type a policy number or the client's name, and press Find. The Delivery Book looks the client up in Salesforce for you.

scenes.headline: What was delivered
scenes.line: Every policy they hold comes up, grouped by type. Tick the policy, and choose what you are handing over. A cheque, a policy contract, or a certificate.

scenes.headline: Their e-mail, from the record
scenes.line: Their e-mail on file is filled in for you. That is where the confirmation goes. If there is none, ask for it, and type it in.

scenes.headline: The handover
scenes.line: Step three. The handover. Who collected it, and their name. Then their signature, with a finger on the screen. A cheque also needs a photo.

scenes.headline: Stamped where it happened
scenes.line: Your location is stamped when you save. It stays with the branch, and never goes to the client.

scenes.headline: One press, on the record
scenes.line: Press Record the delivery. You get a reference at once, and the delivery goes on the client's record in Salesforce.

scenes.headline: Told the same minute
scenes.line: The client gets an e-mail the same minute. What was delivered, on which policy, who collected it, and who delivered it. And five stars, to rate us.

scenes.headline: Every delivery, in one book
scenes.line: The Book tab holds every delivery, the old Jotform ones included. Search a client, a policy or a collector. The ratings from clients are there too.

scenes.headline: Recorded. Confirmed.
scenes.line: Cheques and contracts, in the Delivery Book. The client told, the same day.
